notes: Rubber-tyred metro: running pads outside 1,435 mm steel rails; current via side contact shoes on the guide bars (750 V DC), recorded as third_rail. doorsPerSide = 3 per side per car x 8 cars (derived). Max speed 100 km/h design, 80 km/h service. accelerationMs2 = 4.86 km/h/s maximum converted to m/s2 (derived); only an emergency deceleration (5 km/h/s) is given, so decelerationMs2 is null. Fully automated (driverless) on Line 14; no GoA grade stated, so automationGrade is empty. Figures from Wikipedia (secondary).
